verdict.rationale: Dover documents offer management with e-signing and an API that can list hires, but its integrations list (calendar, email, Slack, Zoom, job boards, AI tools) includes no HRIS or payroll connectors. Nothing shows a signed offer flowing into onboarding without re-entry. The API's 'list hires' endpoint is only a developer building block and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an operations lead, a signed offer flows into onboarding — HRIS and payroll integrations carry the new hire's data over without re-entry
